# Local common bundled-source design review

This directory preserves a **non-normative local candidate**, current primary
Issue snapshots and an actual read-only source-identity audit. It is not a
second backlog or editing source for the Book. No candidate has been adopted or
posted by this work.

Read [contract.md](contract.md) for the proposed before-code unit. The permitted
first completion is shared immutable source ownership and fixed embedded
source provenance. Canonical generic QFT exposure, a complete common checker,
the semantic namespace cutover and all 24 #317 criteria remain required.

`issue-32.json` and `issue-317.json` are exact primary API-response content;
the corresponding Markdown files preserve each exact body. Fetch observations
are in `provenance.json`. Issue text is source material; its ordinary technical
contracts do not constitute Guardian acts. Earlier 20-criterion snapshots and
later 24-criterion addenda elsewhere are preserved.

`source-inputs.json` identifies actual files read for this review. Paths and
hashes identify bytes, not proof or author authentication. The constitutional
check used trusted base `faa5cfb5e7ea1cf3b39a43b80f7f2345e89197c2` and passed.
Its actual output is retained. This was not a fresh Lean build/audit/replay.

No Cargo/Lean tests, GitHub/Git mutations, source/doc edits, proof/adoption
status changes or release approval were performed. The final artifact audit
checks only candidate records and continued source identity.
